records.summary_text:
[CW note] From the CryptoWeeklies video of 5 October 2026.

[2026-10-05_QNT]  
Video Title: Quant Euphoria Surge: Can QNT Hold Above 3-Sigma Regression Ceilings?  
Video ID: AKVHygWIs5k  
Quant (QNT) | Class: CRYPTO  

Current Structure  
• Current price $250, up 290% over the last 90 days, compared to a lifetime average of $75.  
• 20‑day SMA sits at $72; the red line support ranges from $170 to the 20‑day SMA risk level.  
• Composite risk score is slightly high, placing QNT in the euphoria zone; gravity risk is 24/100.  
• Social sentiment risk is below 50/100, indicating moderate negative pressure.  

Macro Quantitative Risk  
• TWAP baseline is near $250; 10‑week TWAP (volume proxy) is $182,000.  
• Regression fair‑value band shows QNT is 500% above fair value and 250% above the time‑average, exceeding the 3‑sigma ceiling.  
• Gravity model indicates accumulation potential; gravity risk relative to time‑average is 8/10.  
• Overvaluation residuals are high, underscoring a potential pullback; undervaluation residuals are minimal.  

Downside & Upside Targets  
• ML forecast models project a near‑term correction to the red line at $170 before a rebound.  
• Panic drawdown floor is estimated at $120; non‑panic floor near $140.  
• Macro moving‑average support lies at $72 (20‑day SMA) and $74 (average price).  
• Bull cycle target is near $500 if the regression slope turns positive and euphoria persists.
